10023.name: Meyer Drossel
10023.description: Meyer Drossel was always fascinated with technology even since early childhood. His father noticed this passion and took him to work in "Ardheim" factory, and since then boy coudn't get enough of the assembly workshops. Later, some terrible tragedy deprived Meyer of his father, but not of his love for technology. After the accident at the factory, he went back there and spent several years studying development and designs of Ardheim engineers and his father.

10026.name: Devulon
10026.description: Devulon stood out even among the rest of the fanatics. His research on the occultism was not understood by the other cultists, as well as by Hierarch himself. Eventually, the Supreme decided to carry out a little cleansing among his henchmen. Devulon was not happy with the prospect of ending his days on the sacrificial altar and fled. He surrendered to those who were not subject to the power of the hierarch, the Resistance, and they found use of his abilities...

10030.name: Rhino Varentas
10030.description: Once Rhino was the Supreme Guardian of the Emper Order, and at the cost of his own life he swore to protect Castian, the Grand Master. However, it was he who was accused of hiring the Riftheim Hangmen to kill the latter. Expelled from the Order in disgrace, Rhino was forced to cooperate with the Forgotten Legion to survive. Wishing revenge on those who unfairly slandered him and ruined his life, Varentas was one of the first to voluntarily agree to stuff himself with a mutagen in the hope of becoming stronger.

10579.name: Elite Psionic
10579.description: The elite of the "ionite" army. At first glance, it may seem that they don't pose any threat, but in fact, a frail body and a huge head hide a monstrous psionic power. In addition to delivering powerful strikes of psionic energy, they act as brain centers, leading the rest of the infected.

10580.name: Elite Resurrected miner
10580.description: Even the dead ones can't escape the crystal entity. After a while, the dead are resurrected under the influence of the crystal, and merge into an obedient army of its servants. The crystal entity worked much harder on the "runners", as the soldiers call them, since they were already dead it was much easier to make the needed changes. Huge claws, strengthened muscles and elastic joints of these creatures are just perfect for battles in tight mines.

10582.name: Elite Enslaved miner
10582.description: The miners were the first and not the most successful slaves of the psionic Call. Without the necessary knowledge, Crystal only changed their bodies minimally for fear of damaging a fragile human body.

10585.name: Elite Juggernaut
10585.description: These creatures were once humans too, they were one of the last ones to be caught in the crystal net. With a considerable amount of knowledge in the human anatomy and knowing the enemy it will have to face, the cold mind of the crystal has changed them so much that the most terrible nightmares pale in comparison with them. Their huge stature, monstrous physical strength and crystal skin make them exceptionally dangerous opponents.

10591.name: Lost Light
10591.description: Commander Grant asked Colonel Elsa Lightsteel to put an end to the bloodshed caused by fightings for the right to control the Brenner line. At the time Elsa Lightsteel was carrying out a secret mission on the eastern frontiers of the Steel Empire. She had a rigid temper, so she managed to introduce proper order in the sector entrusted to her, becoming lord governor during the construction of Fort Attenwald.

Cypher had escaped the country as soon as the war started and fate brought him to the Forgotten Legion. He was forced to conduct experiments which were beyond any moral and ethical values. Doctor flew off the handle, attacked his subordinates and dispersed gas through the ventilation system of the scientific complex. All the people were killed.
